description:
BROE auctioneers welcomes you to a substantial three bedroom residence extending to approximately (120 sq m). Ideally positioned on a quiet cul de sac, tree lined residential street in the highly sought after suburb of Donnybrook. Split over 3 levels this fine home is further enhanced by a magnificent south east facing rear garden and large balcony. The property also benefits from an impressive newly installed main bathroom and no onward chain. In need of light modernization, accommodation briefly comprises entrance hallway, guest WC, kitchen/dining area, utility, a generously proportioned large living room. Upstairs on the first floor are 2 bedrooms master ensuite with access to southeast facing balcony and main bathroom. Bedroom 3 is located on the top floor & this makes for comfortable family living. The location has always been very desirable and with some justification - convenience to the city centre, walking distance to Donnybrook village, UCD and an excellent choice of primary and secondary premier schools.

Viewing highly recommended.

Contact Craig Leap of BROE auctioneers to register your interest.
